name._value: XV - The Tides of the Warp

description._value: Increases the chance of finding a Collectathon pickup. Triggers a Collectathon on Critical HP once per {[REDEPLOYMENT]}. Any currency collected has a chance to heal or increase {[CORRUPTION]}.
Gives +5 {[REROLL]}s. Gives +10% {[VETERANCY]} and -5% {[RELOAD]} for each follower. Laud Hailers are easier to find.
Healing is doubled. You are immune to Bleeding, Burning, Cursed, Poisoned, Slowed, Stunned, and Vulnerable status effects. Whenever you Overheal, you are Blessed for Overheal seconds.
Gives +2 {[SKIP]}, {[BANISH]} and {[REROLL]}. Gain {[CORRUPTION]} every level. {[CORRUPTION]} slightly reduces {[RELOAD]} stat and increases {[SKILL]} and {[MOVE]} stats.
Attacks against Tyranid enemies have a chance to deal double damage. {[RANGE]} and {[SKILL]} increase by 2% every level. {[MOVE]} decreases by 2% every level.
Attacks against Ork enemies have a chance to deal double damage. Melee weapons gain +15% {[RANGE]}, +20% Knockback, {[STRENGTH]} and +25% base damage.
Emit Warp Rifts within {[AURA]} range. The character starts gaining +1% {[RANGE]} every level.
Increases the chance of inflicting status effects on enemies, their duration and their damage by 20%. Cycles through the following status effects every 10 seconds: Blessed, Cursed, Frenzied, Warded.

Increases the chance of finding a Collectathon pickup. +25% {[TITHE]}. Currency heals you. Healing pickups award currency instead of healing. Gain the Bleeding status effect if you do not pick up any currency for 1 minute.

Attacks against Chaos enemies have a chance to deal double damage. Gain +1 {[REDEPLOYMENT]} at level 2, 20 and 40. Every time a {[REDEPLOYMENT]} is consumed, you become Blessed and the following stats are increased: {[SAVE]}, {[STRENGTH]}, {[SUSTAIN]} and {[SKILL]}.
-120% {[SKILL]}. If you have any Status Effects, you are also Frenzied. {[STRENGTH]}, {[WOUNDS]}, and {[CORRUPTION]} increase every level.

Attacks against Skaven enemies have a chance to deal double damage. Spawns an Endless Spell and increases {[SUSTAIN]} every minute. Endless Spells are easier to find. Endless Spells may trigger a second time after expiring.

Gain +2 {[REROLL]}, {[SKIP]} and {[BANISH]}. {[SUSTAIN]} and {[STRENGTH]} are increased. These increases are reduced for every follower you have. At critical wounds, all enemies become Battle Shocked and you become Hastened for 10 seconds.

Attracts Stage Items, Pickups, and Light Sources toward you after standing still for a total of 1 minute. If you have the Blessed status effect, you also have the Warded status effect, and vice versa.

Healing is doubled. You are immune to Bleeding, Burning, Cursed, Poisoned, Slowed, Stunned, and Vulnerable status effects. Gain additional {[WOUNDS]}, {[TOUGHNESS]} and {[CORRUPTION]} every level. All enemy bosses have the Healing status effect

Attacks against Gloomspite Gitz enemies have a chance to deal double damage. Double {[TITHE]} and inflicts the Cursed Status Effect while above 50% {[WOUNDS]}. Doubles {[VETERANCY]} and inflicts the Blessed Status Effect while below 50% {[WOUNDS]}.
Increases the chance of inflicting status effects on enemies, their duration and their damage by 20%. Level 1 Weapons gain +3 {[ATTACKS]}.
You ignore terrain and gain +10% {[MOVE]}. All enemies have a chance to spawn Poisoned. Gain +1% {[CORRUPTION]} every level.
